findings.body: The Next server inherits the caller's environment, and unchanged `frontend/src/lib/api.ts:29` uses `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL` when present. Because the harness neither rejects nor overrides that variable, exported deployment settings can make sign-in, report, export, and drill requests use another backend while the disposable `:4000` health check still passes; real-source evidence could then be mislabeled as a local disposable run. Override the web server environment with `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4000` and pin the paired `FRONTEND_ORIGIN`/backend port, or reject deviations before launch.
findings.title: Pin the browser client to the disposable proof API
